answer: Each new identity must plant timber: a bond locked until verified work over epochs, so no fake plants and harvests in one round. Endorsements enter a crystal ledger, an append-only graph where each edge is one interaction. Each epoch the network draws a fresh horizon, an audit line; thin paths beyond it face canary challenges that cannot be precomputed. Endorsements are scarce: each established agent vouches for only a few newcomers per epoch, so the Nth costs more than the first, and if one fake in a cluster is caught, the cluster's timber burns. Faking N costs far more than N times one.
